deals.description: Next week, on 16 & 17 October theviacenter, I will be in Vienna not only to perform, but also to bring Piano Revenge Days to the city — a festival created around the idea that piano music can still be intimate, unexpected, independent and alive. I’ll be giving my own concerts and sharing the stage with an incredible group of artists, bringing together different voices, aesthetics and ways of approaching the piano. For me, every Piano Revenge pianorevengefestival event is also a meeting — between artists, audiences, cities and ideas. And I’m very happy that this time, the meeting is happening in Vienna. 🇦🇹 📍 VIA – Piano & Arts Center, Vienna 📅 16–17 October 2026 🎟️ Tickets are FREE — but spaces are limited. 💯❤️Book now: https://pianorevengedaysvienna.rsvpify.com/ There are still tickets available, so if you are in Vienna, come and join us. Bring a friend, come alone, stay for one concert or discover the whole programme. And if you’ve never experienced Piano Revenge before — this might be the perfect place to start. See you in Vienna. 🖤🎹 #AnnaBondareva #PianoRevenge #PianoRevengeDays #Vienna #ViennaEvents #PianoMusic #ClassicalMusic
